title: The Shadowed Gunslinger
description: A silhouetted figure in a black cowboy hat and purple cape sits on a stool playing an acoustic guitar while holding a revolver across his lap. The dark scene features floating cattle skulls, barbed wire, piano keys in the background, and a hanging lantern casting dramatic light.
